cmd_desktop_agent_display_gone: The display process ended before Atlas could record it
cmd_desktop_agent_helper_exited: {program} exited with {status} before it was ready: {output}
cmd_desktop_agent_helper_timeout: {program} was not ready after {secs} s. See {path}.
cmd_desktop_agent_not_on_windows: Agent instances (`atlas desktop --agent`) are not available on this system.
cmd_desktop_agent_runtime_dir: {path} is the XDG_RUNTIME_DIR of this shell, so Atlas does not run an agent display in it.
cmd_desktop_agent_tool_missing: {tool} not found. An agent instance needs a headless Wayland compositor: on Arch run `pacman -S sway grim`, on Debian or Ubuntu run `apt install sway grim dbus`.
cmd_desktop_bad_install_path: {path} is not a valid install location
cmd_desktop_bridge_bad_reply: The debug bridge sent a reply Atlas cannot read
cmd_desktop_bridge_closed: The debug bridge closed the connection: the app exited or crashed. Start a new instance with `atlas desktop --agent`.
cmd_desktop_bridge_error: The debug bridge reported an error
cmd_desktop_bun_failed: Couldn't run `bun` to evaluate the script. Check that bun is installed.
cmd_desktop_display_mismatch: Refusing to start: the environment of the instance does not point at its private display ({reason})
cmd_desktop_dry_run_silent: The dry run exited without logging its decision
cmd_desktop_ended_settling: The instance ended while it was settling (interrupted or crashed); Atlas stopped it.
cmd_desktop_exited_early: The app exited with {status} before it was ready. See {path}.
cmd_desktop_installer_no_app: The installer finished, but {path} is missing. Run `atlas desktop --install` again.
cmd_desktop_installer_wrong_version: The installer left Atlas Desktop {found}, but {expected} was expected. Run `atlas desktop --install` again.
cmd_desktop_instance_exists: Agent instance "{name}" already exists ({path}). Run `atlas desktop --agent --stop --name {name}` first, or pick another --name.
cmd_desktop_interrupted: Interrupted before the instance was ready; Atlas stopped it.
cmd_desktop_linked_notice: Atlas Desktop is linked to a dev build ({path}) and was left alone. Run `atlas unlink` to update it.
cmd_desktop_linked_to_dev: {path} is linked to a dev build (`atlas link --desktop`). Run `atlas unlink` first.
cmd_desktop_lock_timeout: Another agent instance is starting (it holds {path}) and Atlas waited {secs} s. If none is starting, delete the file.
cmd_desktop_lock_waiting: atlas-agent: another instance is starting (lock {path}); waiting for its turn
cmd_desktop_move_aside_failed: Couldn't move {path} aside to update it
cmd_desktop_name_chars: The name can contain only letters, digits, hyphens and _
cmd_desktop_name_length: The name must have 1 to 24 characters
cmd_desktop_no_bridge: No debug bridge at {path}. Start an agent instance with `atlas desktop --agent` (or `bun run desktop:agent`), then set ATLAS_DEBUG_SOCK to the socket it prints.
cmd_desktop_no_bun: Couldn't run `bun`. Install bun, then run `atlas desktop --dev` again.
cmd_desktop_no_cwd: Couldn't read the current folder. Run the command from a folder that exists, or pass an absolute path.
cmd_desktop_no_debug_build: No debug build of Atlas Desktop under {path}/target/debug. Build it with `cargo build -p atlas-cli -p atlas-desktop` (the frontend is served through Vite by `bun run desktop:agent`) or with `bun run desktop:build:app`.
cmd_desktop_no_home: Couldn't find your home folder. Set HOME and try again.
cmd_desktop_no_menu_entry: Couldn't add a menu entry ({reason}). Start Atlas Desktop with {path}.
cmd_desktop_no_such_instance: No agent instance named {name}. Start one with `atlas desktop --agent --name {name}`.
cmd_desktop_not_agent_mode: The app started but is not in agent mode (is this a release build?), so Atlas stopped it.
cmd_desktop_not_appimage: {path} is not an AppImage (expected an executable ELF file)
cmd_desktop_not_atlas_repo: {path} is not the atlas repo: it has no apps/desktop. Run `atlas desktop --dev` inside a checkout of the atlas repo.
cmd_desktop_not_installer: {path} is not an Atlas installer (expected a -setup.exe file)
cmd_desktop_not_your_dir: {path} is not a folder of yours, so Atlas does not stop what it names.
cmd_desktop_pkg_missing_binary: The package installed, but /usr/bin/atlas-desktop is missing. Run `atlas desktop --appimage` to install the AppImage instead.
cmd_desktop_script_kind: The script must be a .json, .ts or .js file (got "{extension}")
cmd_desktop_script_not_utf8: The script printed output that is not UTF-8 text
cmd_desktop_socket_too_long: The socket path {path} is {length} bytes, over the limit of {max}. Use a shorter --name.
cmd_desktop_status_missing: Atlas Desktop: not installed. Run `atlas desktop` to install it.
cmd_desktop_status_packaged: Atlas Desktop: {path} (from a distro package; update it with your package manager)
cmd_desktop_update_rolled_back: Atlas Desktop update failed; the previous install was restored
cmd_desktop_window_refused: The app refused to show its window and exited with {status}: {line}
cmd_desktop_window_timeout: The window was not shown after {secs} s. See {path}.
